questions.question: In Terminator 2: Judgment Day, what is the liquid-metal terminator called?
questions.note: Robert Patrick; Arnold’s T-800 is the protector this time.

questions.question: Who played Trinity in The Matrix?
questions.note: Keanu Reeves is Neo; Laurence Fishburne is Morpheus.

questions.question: In Jurassic Park, which character says “Clever girl” just before the raptors attack?
questions.note: Game warden Robert Muldoon, played by Bob Peck.

questions.question: What is the name of Neve Campbell’s heroine in the Scream films?
questions.note: Wes Craven’s 1996 original. Bristow is Jennifer Garner’s Alias spy.

questions.question: Which 1999 found-footage horror film is about three student filmmakers lost in the woods?
questions.note: A marketing legend; it looked like a real missing-persons case.

questions.question: In the 2017 film It, what is the name of the Maine town terrorized by Pennywise?
questions.note: Stephen King country. Castle Rock is another of his fictional towns.

questions.question: In Avatar, what is the name of the mineral humans are mining on Pandora?
questions.note: Spelled that way in the film, on purpose. The Na’vi live over the richest deposit.

questions.question: In Black Panther, what is the name of the metal that comes from Wakanda?
questions.note: Captain America’s shield is also vibranium; adamantium is the X-Men’s (and Wolverine’s) metal.

questions.question: In Denis Villeneuve’s Dune films, what is the name of the desert planet?
questions.note: Also called Dune; the spice is melange. Caladan is the Atreides homeworld.

questions.question: Who directed and starred in A Quiet Place (2018)?
questions.note: Blunt co-stars as his wife; the creatures hunt by sound.
